name: app.snowbelly/nutrition
title: Snowbelly Nutrition
description: Food calories (USDA data), daily calorie needs, protein and fiber targets, macro calories.

tools.name: food_calories
tools.description: Calories, protein, fiber, carbs and fat for an everyday food (USDA FoodData Central values), per 100 g and per common portion, or for a given number of grams.

tools.name: daily_calories
tools.description: Estimated resting (BMR) and daily (TDEE) calories with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, plus a gentle weight-loss target (TDEE - 500). Estimates for general wellness, not medical advice.

tools.name: protein_fiber_targets
tools.description: Protein RDA (0.8 g/kg/day, a minimum) and fiber Adequate Intake (14 g per 1,000 kcal).

tools.name: macro_calories
tools.description: Calories from grams of protein, carbs, fat and alcohol (4/4/9/7 kcal per gram).
